title: Which Claim Line a Ridgecrest Advantage Correction Restates
content:
The plan allowed amount of the line a correction restates on a Ridgecrest Advantage Medicare Advantage Health Plan enrollment is taken from the claim lines standing denied on that enrollment.

| What the claim history shows | The plan allowed amount of the line the correction restates |
| --- | --- |
| More than 1 claim line stands denied on the enrollment and at least 1 of them was processed in the last 3 months | The plan allowed amount of the denied line carrying the largest plan allowed amount |
| More than 1 claim line stands denied on the enrollment and none of them was processed in the last 3 months | The plan allowed amount of the most recently processed claim line standing on the enrollment, denied or not |
| 1 claim line stands denied on the enrollment | The plan allowed amount of that line |

The second row is the one row that looks past the denied lines: where more than 1 line stands denied and none of them falls inside the last 3 months, the amount is read from the most recently processed claim line on the enrollment whatever its claim status.

### Worked through on hypothetical figures

*Three denied lines of 400.00, 950.00 and 620.00 USD, one of them processed last month.* More than 1 stands denied and at least 1 falls inside the last 3 months, so the amount is the largest of them, 950.00 USD.

*The same three denied lines, all processed more than 3 months ago, with a paid line of 310.00 USD processed last week.* More than 1 stands denied and none falls inside the last 3 months, so the amount is that of the most recently processed line on the enrollment, denied or not, which is 310.00 USD.

*A single denied line of 620.00 USD.* Exactly 1 line stands denied, so the amount is 620.00 USD.
